keyFindings.description: Main's 184897ac (#2419) makes changelog entries fragment files (AGENTS.md:151): never edit a CHANGELOG.md, and an open PR moves its entries from the old section (now '## Before changelog fragments') into fragments the next time it merges main. Merge 10bc21e1 is that merge but kept six entries in packages/{contracts,envoy,envoy-client,claude-envoy}/CHANGELOG.md, and no .changes/unreleased file exists. The fold builds release blocks only from fragments (release-push.sh), so these entries never reach a release or main@<commit> heading. Reset the four CHANGELOG.md files to main's text, and write each entry as packages/<pkg>/.changes/unreleased/INFRA-156-<slug>.yaml (kind Added or Fixed, body as a |- block).

:1721-1722 still says a quote, <, =, > and backtick 'end' the shortcut. Only a space, tab, line ending, #, . and } end it; the others make the editor read the line as no directive (as directive.go:373-379 says).
